snippet.title: Echoes of Elysium – Official Early Access Launch Trailer | Available NOW with 10% Discount
snippet.description:
Echoes of Elysium is AVAILABLE NOW in Early Access.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2644050/Echoes_of_Elysium/

For launch week only, get 10% OFF the regular price.

Echoes of Elysium is a survival RPG where you and up to 6 friends build, explore, and fight to survive among the floating isles of a shattered afterworld. Construct your airship, brave deadly storms, and uncover ancient secrets buried in the clouds.

Features

- Co-op for up to 6 players
- Build and customize your own airship
- Gather resources, craft, and survive across floating islands
- Battle skyborne threats alone or with friends
- Discover the truth behind Elysium’s fall

🚀 AVAILABLE NOW - Launch Week 10% Discount
👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/2644050/Echoes_of_Elysium/
